name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: Quick tasks on touch screens, such as share or move.

motionProfile.reason: Drawer owns its popup edge flight, the independently owned backdrop opacity, the popup's measured content height, scoped paint and owned title/description display while Base UI keeps the swipe, snap and release gesture.

popup.anchored/one-shot.reason: The popup owns one edge flight whose distance is its own rendered extent while Base UI keeps the swipe and snap transform.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: The backdrop owns one opacity entrance on its own rendered host, sharing the native swipe-progress channel instead of adding a second one.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: A closing backdrop fades on that same channel while the popup returns to its own edge and Base UI keeps the native unmount protocol.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: The popup shell owns one clamped measured block-size transaction over its natural content while no native snap height is active.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Backdrop, title and description each own their declared scoped paint on their own physical region, with focus and unverified palettes immediate; the popup settles its supplied paint immediately because its single transition family is Base UI's swipe and release channel.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: A directly supplied plain Title or Description string replaces only its changed graphemes; arbitrary rich children keep their native identity.

number.roll/reels.reason: A directly supplied supported numeric quantity in Title or Description rolls only its changed places; strings and identifiers remain text.
